Exterior and interior

The Kona Electric brings electrified energy to its compact SUV stance, with sleek aero-optimised wheels, a closed front grille, and dynamic LED lighting that signals its eco credentials. Inside, it balances futuristic tech with everyday comfort. Soft-touch materials, a floating infotainment screen, and spacious seating make it feel upscale. A flat-floor layout adds practicality, and rear-seat comfort ensures it works as a family car too.

Technology and features

The Hyundai Kona Electric is packed with user-friendly tech, including a 12.3-inch curved dual-screen setup that merges a crisp digital driver display with a responsive infotainment touchscreen. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto come as standard, with over-the-air updates and connected services available through Hyundai’s Bluelink app. Higher trims include features like a premium Harman Kardon sound system, ambient lighting, and a head-up display for added convenience. The Kona also offers smart key access, remote start, and an efficient heat pump for optimised battery performance in colder weather.

Putting safety first

The Hyundai Kona Electric comes packed with Hyundai SmartSense driver-assist features, including Blind‑Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist and Rear Cross‑Traffic Collision-Avoidance, which is capable of applying brakes when a threat is detected. It also offers Lane Following/Lane Keeping Assist, Highway Driving Assist 2.0 with adaptive cruise and stop‑and‑go functionality, plus Leading Vehicle Departure Alert. Unique to this model are Safe Exit Warning and Rear Seat Alert, which help prevent accidents when disembarking or leaving items behind.
